benchmark.schedule: warmup once, then round-major interleaving of all six tiers with distinct per-(round, tier) seeds

warmup.vllm_bench_command: vllm bench serve --backend openai-chat --endpoint /v1/chat/completions --base-url http://127.0.0.1:8201 --model Qwen/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B --tokenizer /models/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B --dataset-name random --random-input-len 512 --random-output-len 128 --random-range-ratio 0.0 --num-prompts 32 --max-concurrency 16 --ignore-eos --temperature 0.0 --seed 21161111 --percentile-metrics ttft,tpot,itl --metric-percentiles 99 --save-result --result-dir docs/benchmarks/phase2_vllm_raw --result-filename warmup.json
